responsibility: This machine description implements the MIPS SIMD Architecture (MSA) instruction set in GCC. It defines the MSA UNSPEC codes, vector mode iterators and mode attributes, and a broad set of patterns for vector arithmetic, logic, shifts, inserts, lane splats, conversions, loads/stores, control-register moves, comparisons, and vector branches, forming the main instruction-selection layer that maps GCC vector operations and MSA builtins onto the 128-bit MSA ISA.
